heuristics.name: Be Specific
heuristics.headline: NAME THE FILES, THE CASES, AND THE TOOLS
heuristics.do:
Write pytest tests for foo.py covering two cases:
  • logged-out user
  • expired token
No mocks — use the test client in tests/conftest.py.
heuristics.why: Naming the file, the exact cases, and the tools to use removes guesswork and stops the agent from inventing its own scope.

heuristics.name: Give Examples
heuristics.headline: AN INPUT/OUTPUT PAIR PINS THE CONTRACT
heuristics.dont: parse the dates in this CSV
heuristics.do:
Parse the `created` column.
Example:
  "2026-03-09T14:00Z"
   → 1773064800000 (epoch ms)
Three more pairs in tests/fixtures/dates.json — match them exactly.
heuristics.why: A concrete input → output pair (or a unit test) pins the contract far better than prose. Tests are executable examples the agent can run.

heuristics.name: Decompose
heuristics.headline: ONE COHERENT STEP AT A TIME
heuristics.dont: migrate the whole app from REST to GraphQL
heuristics.do: Step 1 only: expose the existing /users endpoint as a GraphQL query. Leave REST in place. Don't touch other endpoints yet.
heuristics.why: Small steps keep the diff reviewable and the context small. Migrate one service, not ten — then iterate on the next.

heuristics.name: Remove Ambiguity
heuristics.headline: KILL EVERY "THIS", "THAT", "THE OTHER ONE"
heuristics.dont: fix it so this works like the other one
heuristics.do: In PaymentForm.tsx, make the submit button disable-on-submit exactly like CheckoutForm.tsx (lines 40–62). Reuse the useDisableOnSubmit hook.
heuristics.why: Vague pronouns force the agent to guess which thing you mean. Name the file, the function, and the line range.

heuristics.name: Point to Existing Patterns
heuristics.headline: ANCHOR THE OUTPUT TO YOUR CODEBASE
heuristics.do:
Create a HotDogWidget that follows HamburgerWidget.tsx exactly:
  • same props shape
  • same folder layout
  • same test-file structure
heuristics.why: Pointing at a reference file makes the output match your conventions instead of a generic internet style. “Follow the pattern in X.”

heuristics.name: Iterate
heuristics.headline: REPHRASE; DON'T PILE UP CORRECTIONS
heuristics.dont:
no, fix the colors too
…still broken
…now the header is wrong
(all in one growing thread)
heuristics.do:
That approach used global state — let's restart.
New prompt: implement the cart with a local reducer, following CartContext.tsx.
heuristics.why: After two failed corrections, /clear and rewrite the first prompt. Stacked fixes pollute the context and entrench the wrong approach.
